verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents organization-scoped, reusable HTTP webhook destinations that attach to monitoring rules. Those rules turn any SQL query into an alert with an operator, threshold, interval and severity. That is a real, registrable outbound HTTP callback a programmatic consumer can receive. However, the only subscribable events are alert-rule firings; there is no evidence of webhooks for platform events such as cluster changes, batch-job progress or schema deploys. Missing for 10: general event-type subscriptions beyond alert rules, payload format and signing/retry documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
